description: This file contains a static helper class 'TH' providing utility functions for error handling and exception generation within the PDFsharp library, specifically related to PDF processing errors, encryption issues, and crypt filter management.

classes.name: TH
classes.description: A static throw helper class providing methods to generate specific exceptions and error messages for PDF processing errors, encryption, crypt filters, and SASLprep issues within the PDFsharp library.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_CouldNotFindMetadataDictionary
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException indicating the metadata dictionary could not be found in the PDF document.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_ReferenceMustNotBeNull
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException indicating a null reference was encountered where it should not be.

methods.name: ObjectNotAvailableException_CannotRetrieveStreamLength
methods.description: Creates an ObjectNotAvailableException indicating the stream length could not be retrieved, optionally including an inner exception.

methods.name: EndOfStreamException_CouldNotReadToStreamEnd
methods.description: Creates an EndOfStreamException indicating reading the stream to its end was unsuccessful, optionally including an inner exception.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_ReferencesOfObjectStreamNotYetRead
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException indicating references in the object stream are not yet read.

methods.name: PdfReaderException_ObjectCouldNotBeFoundInObjectStreams
methods.description: Creates a PdfReaderException indicating that an object could not be found in the object streams.

methods.name: PdfReaderException_UnknownEncryption
methods.description: Creates a PdfReaderException indicating that an unsupported encryption method was encountered.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_NoEncryptionSet
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException indicating that encryption has not been set but is required.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_EncryptionRevisionValueNotYetCalculated
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException indicating that the encryption revision value has not been calculated.

methods.name: CryptographicException_InputDataTooShort
methods.description: Creates a CryptographicException indicating that the input data is too short for encryption.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_InvalidVersionValueForEncryptionVersion1To4
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException for invalid version values for encryption versions 1-4.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_InvalidPasswordKeyLengthForEncryptionVersion1To4
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException for invalid password key lengths in encryption versions 1-4.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_EncryptionKeyNotSetForEncryptionVersion1To4
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException indicating the encryption key is not set for encryption versions 1-4.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_InvalidKeyLengthForEncryptionVersion2
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException when the key length for V2 encryption is invalid.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_AESNotSupportedForChosenEncryptionVersion
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException indicating AES is not supported in the selected encryption version.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_InvalidVersionValueForEncryptionVersion5
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException for invalid version values for encryption version 5.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_InvalidRevisionValueForEncryptionVersion5
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException for invalid revision values for encryption version 5.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_InvalidLengthValueForEncryptionVersion5
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException when the length value is invalid for encryption version 5.

methods.name: PdfReaderException_CouldNotVerifyPWithPermsKey
methods.description: Creates a PdfReaderException indicating failure to verify permissions key in an encrypted document.

methods.name: NotImplementedException_EncryptEmbeddedFileStreamsOnlyCurrentlyShutOff
methods.description: Creates a NotImplementedException indicating embedded file stream encryption is currently disabled.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_InvalidVersionForEncryptEmbeddedFilesOnly
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException for incorrect version use when encrypting embedded files.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_MissingDefaultCryptFilter
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException indicating a missing default crypt filter.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_CryptFiltersNotSupportedForChosenEncryptionVersion
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException when crypt filters are unsupported for the chosen encryption version.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_CryptFiltersNotSupportedForChosenEncryptionRevision
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException when crypt filters are unsupported for the chosen encryption revision.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_CryptFiltersNeededForChosenEncryptionVersion
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException indicating crypt filters are needed for the chosen encryption version.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_InvalidCryptFilterMethod
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException for invalid crypt filter method.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_InvalidCryptFilterMethodForEncryptionRevision4
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException if an invalid crypt filter method is used for encryption revision 4.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_InvalidCryptFilterMethodForEncryptionRevision6
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException if an invalid crypt filter method is used for encryption revision 6.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_InvalidLengthValueForCryptFilterMethodV2
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException for invalid key length for crypt filter method V2.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_InvalidLengthValueForCryptFilterMethodAESV2
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException for invalid key length for AESV2 crypt filter method.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_InvalidLengthValueForCryptFilterMethodAESV3
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException for invalid key length for AESV3 crypt filter method.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_CryptFilterDecodeParmsNotInitializedCorrectly
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException indicating crypt filter decode parameters are not initialized correctly.

methods.name: ArgumentException_UnknownCryptFilter
methods.description: Creates an ArgumentException when an unknown crypt filter is specified.

methods.name: ArgumentException_UnknownCryptFilterSetToDefault
methods.description: Creates an ArgumentException when an unknown crypt filter is set as default.

methods.name: ArgumentException_WrappingSASLprepException
methods.description: Creates an ArgumentException wrapping exceptions during SASLprep processing.

methods.name: ArgumentException_SASLprepProhibitedCharacter
methods.description: Creates an ArgumentException indicating a prohibited character in SASLprep encoding.

methods.name: ArgumentException_SASLprepProhibitedUnassignedCodepoint
methods.description: Creates an ArgumentException indicating a prohibited unassigned code point in SASLprep.

methods.name: ArgumentException_SASLprepRandALCatAndLCatCharacters
methods.description: Creates an ArgumentException indicating a violation of bidirectional character requirements in SASLprep.

methods.name: ArgumentException_SASLprepRandALCatButFirstOrLastDivergent
methods.description: Creates an ArgumentException indicating divergence at the string's start or end in SASLprep.
